text.Orbital Platform:
How to Play ==
When you play Orbital Platform you may discard a card. If you do draw a a card. If the ally ability triggers you gain 3 Combat. 
 Strategy   ==
Good base with the cost of only 3 Trade. The possibility to throw of a lesser card for a possible better card is nice. Adding 3 extra Combat when the ally ability triggers is good too.
text.Orbital Gun Platform:
How to play ==
At any time during your turn, gain 3 Combat. You can also scrap this card to gain 3 Trade. Orbital Gun Platform is an outpost with a defense of 4. 
 Strategy ==
Orbital Gun Platform is identical to Bioformer, except that it is yellow rather than green and that this is an outpost. This doesn't really make a difference for the strategy, so see comments on that card if you're interested.
